goal: Add the recipes from recipes.jpg in Simple Gallery Pro to the Broccoli recipe app.
summary:
I added all three recipes from recipes.jpg to Broccoli and saved each one, with one small difference. The Lemon Garlic Tilapia directions start with "Saute" instead of "Sauté". The accented "é" was turned into a plain "e" when I typed it, and the keyboard wouldn't give me the accent.

1. **Lemon Garlic Tilapia**: 2 servings, 4 hrs. Description is "A delicious and healthy choice for any time of the day.", ingredients "to preference", and the sauté-in-butter directions.
2. **Vegetable Stir Fry with Tofu**: 8 servings, 2 hrs. Description is "An ideal recipe for experimenting with different flavors and ingredients.", ingredients "subject to change", and the stir-fry directions.
3. **Sweet Potato and Black Bean Tacos**: 3-4 servings, 4 hrs. Same description as the stir fry, ingredients "n/a", and the roast-and-fill directions.

The image wraps the directions over several lines. I entered each one as a single line with spaces where the lines broke. The image gives no category or source, so those fields are empty.
